description: Manage browser sessions — list open sessions and your tabs in them, see which tab you work in ("status"), create a new one, or close one (pass your tabId to close only that tab of yours). Use "status" to find your current tab id. When a browser tool's answer starts with "Your tab … was lost; a replacement tab … is open", continue in that tab (no create). Use "create" when your browser session or tab was lost (closed, disconnected, "Session not found", "Tab … not found"): it opens a new tab of your own in the SynaBun browser, starting the browser when it is not running, and in a loop or a dispatched run your next browser calls go to it. Only if create fails too, stop and report it; never switch to another browser. Closing a session other automations still use closes only your own tab in it; the session stays open for them.

action.description: "list" = the open sessions with your own tabs (id, address, title; your current tab marked), "status" = the session and tab your browser calls use now, with its address and whether SynaBun replaced a lost tab, "create" = open a new browser tab of your own (starting the browser if needed) and continue there, "close" = close a session.

sessionId.description: Session ID for "close" action. Required for close when multiple sessions exist (or pass your tabId).

tabId.description: Your tab id, as the other browser tools take it. "status" / "list": says whether it is still your current tab (a lost tab names the tab that replaced it). "close": closes only this tab of yours; a tab that is not yours is refused and nothing is closed. Ignored by "create", which always opens a new tab of your own.

name: browser_session
